E06 applies these metrics to PFOS in RAP and compares them with other reactors used by Mahyar et al. The need to account for initial concentration differences is explicitly stated in E02. Frequency optimization for maximum PFAS degradation is compound-specific and not practical for complex PFAS mixtures and actual waters, constraining operational flexibility in real-world IDW treatment.
